instantiated_cells.cited_section: Ohio Rev. Code §§ 101.99(A)-(B) (penalties for violations of §101.71 and §101.77); §121.99(A)-(B) (penalties for violations of §121.61 and §121.67)
instantiated_cells.justification: These penalty sections make specified lobbying-disclosure violations (including knowingly failing to register or file required statements and knowingly filing false statements) criminal misdemeanors, establishing statutory penalties.

The statutes provide for investigation of compliance by the attorney general and public availability of filings, but they do not require any regular, periodic audit of lobbying disclosure records by an impartial third party.
